policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).

policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a nuestro equipo de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify our team immediately.

policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Mezcla refrescante de piña, mango, proteína de vainilla de alta calidad y leche de almendras.
products.descriptionEn: Refreshing blend of pineapple, mango, high-grade vanilla protein, and almond milk.

products.descriptionEs: Base espesa de asaí puro cubierta con granola crujiente, rodajas de plátano fresco, fresas y un toque de miel.
products.descriptionEn: Thick pure açai base topped with crunchy granola, fresh banana slices, strawberries, and a drizzle of honey.

products.descriptionEs: Quinua orgánica, aguacate en rodajas, garbanzos tostados, espinaca fresca y aderezo casero de limón y tahini.
products.descriptionEn: Organic quinoa, sliced avocado, roasted chickpeas, fresh spinach, and house-made lemon tahini dressing.

products.nameEs: Wrap de Pollo y Espinaca al Pesto
products.descriptionEn: Tender grilled chicken breast, house basil pesto, baby spinach, and tomatoes wrapped in a whole wheat tortilla.
Toasted sourdough bread, smashed avocado, poached egg, chia seeds, and red pepper flakes.

products.nameEs: Pudin de Chía con Frutos Rojos
products.descriptionEn: Chia seeds soaked in light coconut milk, naturally sweetened, and topped with wild mixed berries.
Mixed greens, crunchy cucumber, green apple, roasted pumpkin seeds, and light apple cider vinaigrette.
Organic green tea infusion with a hint of fresh mint and natural ginger.
Cold-pressed juice featuring kale, spinach, green apple, lemon, and fresh ginger.

products.nameEs: Batido de Chocolate y Mantequilla de Maní
products.descriptionEn: Chocolate protein, natural peanut butter, banana, and oat milk. A guilt-free treat.

products.nameEs: Panini de Pavo y Queso Panela
products.descriptionEn: Natural turkey breast, fresh panela cheese, tomato, and a touch of Dijon mustard on toasted whole grain bread.

products.nameEs: Agua Fresca de Hibisco y Jengibre
products.descriptionEn: Refreshing infusion of natural hibiscus flowers with a subtle touch of ginger and organic agave.

faqs.qEs: ¿Tienen opciones vegetarianas, veganas o sin gluten?
faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian, vegan, or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, la mayoría de nuestros tazones, batidos y ensaladas cuentan con opciones veganas y sin gluten claramente marcadas en nuestro menú.
faqs.aEn: Yes, most of our bowls, smoothies, and salads feature clearly marked vegan and gluten-free options on our menu.

faqs.qEs: ¿Puedo ordenar comida para llevar o entrega a domicilio?
faqs.qEn: Can I order takeout or delivery?
faqs.aEs: ¡Claro que sí! Puede ordenar por teléfono para recoger en el local o encontrarnos en las principales aplicaciones de entrega.
faqs.aEn: Absolutely! You can order by phone for quick pickup or find us on local delivery apps.
